Uniform convergence in observation angle gives polar boundary asymptotics, exactly one of three cyclic matchings crosses (Pr=1/3), cube-root recovery. The four marked mixed sectors yield one free p(s) point, symmetric label and log-uniform normal-offset exponent; pointwise limiting densities and mass conservation give TV by Scheffé. FFT quadrature verifies uniform special case to numerical precision and anisotropic convergence. Limits exclude p=0, singular measures, dependent endpoints.
